headline: API Reports 2.03 Million Barrel Draw in US Crude Oil Inventories
summary: The American Petroleum Institute estimated that US crude oil inventories fell by 2.031 million barrels for the week ending October 23, extending a 28-week decline in commercial stocks.
why: Weekly inventory data from API is closely tracked by energy markets as a key leading indicator of US supply, refining demand, and crude balance trends ahead of official government data.

impacts.name: Crude Oil WTI
impacts.why: Declining commercial crude inventories point to tightening domestic supply conditions.

why_moved: US crude oil inventories dropped by 2.031 million barrels according to API estimates, reinforcing supply tightness and supporting benchmark crude prices.
